hypotheses.title: Calibrated 6-Day Smoothing on Options Put-to-Call Volume Ratio
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Applies 6-day decay smoothing on close-to-open body reversal to reduce turnover while preserving contrarian options volume information coefficient.
confounders: Over-smoothing of short-term overnight liquidity provision
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if longer decay dampens Sharpe ratio below platform cutoff.

hypotheses.title: 12-Day PCR Volume Decay with 5-Day Smoothing
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Lengthens options volume holding window to 12 days to reduce churn down to ~15-20% and maximize risk-adjusted returns.
confounders: Stale volume ratio signals over extended decay horizons
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if 12-day holding window reduces sub-universe Sharpe below platform threshold.

hypotheses.title: Range-Normalized Intraday Shadow Reversal with PCR Volume Contrarian Squeeze
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Normalizes close-to-open return by intraday true range to eliminate outlier churn on high-beta names.
confounders: Compression of signals in low-volatility regimes
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if true range normalization increases turnover without improving Sharpe.

candidates.expression: group_zscore(ts_decay_linear(ts_backfill(pcr_vol_60, 60), 10), market) - 0.12 * group_zscore(ts_decay_linear((close - open) / (high - low + 0.001 * close), 5), market)
